issues.description: The user is being redirected to the auth page instead of the step-8a render result screen. The URL shows /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-8a, meaning the user is not authenticated and is being blocked from accessing the render result screen. The step-8a page content (AI-redesigned room image, before/after slider, quality score, loading state) is entirely absent.
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-8a route is protected by an authentication middleware or route guard. When the user is not authenticated, they are redirected to /auth with a `next` param. The middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts (or similar) is blocking unauthenticated access to the design flow, so the render result page never renders. This could also be due to a missing or expired session cookie causing Supabase auth check to fail.

issues.description: A 400 error is logged in the console ('Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400'). This likely corresponds to a failed Supabase auth session refresh or OAuth token exchange, preventing automatic re-authentication.
issues.root_cause: The 400 response is likely from a Supabase token refresh endpoint (e.g., /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token) returning an error due to an invalid or expired refresh token. This is in the Supabase client configuration or session handling in apps/web/lib/supabase/ or apps/web/app/auth/.
